title: Billing and Coding: Multiplex Gastrointestinal Pathogen Panel (GPP) Tests for Acute Gastroenteritis (AGE)

codes.2: Highly Multiplexed GPPs- Group 2 Codes Must be billed in POS 20, 21, 22, 23, or 81 (Urgent Care, Inpatient Hospital, Outpatient Hospital (observation), or Emergency Room), or in POS 81 (Independent Laboratory) in the case of a pre-transplant evaluation for an immune-compromised beneficiary. Outside of one of these POS, a clinician specialist in one of the following: Infectious Diseases (44), Gastroenterology (10), Oncology (83,90,91), or Transplant must either order the test or communicate with the treating and ordering physician as to appropriate test and interpretation. The specialist communication must be documented in the medical record. CPT code 0097U was deleted. effective for services rendered on or after 4/1/2022.

covered.1: These are the diagnosis codes corresponding to coverage of CPT Group 1 code.
covered.2: These are the diagnosis codes corresponding to coverage of CPT Group 2 codes- Highly Multiplexed GPPs. One of these diagnosis codes must be on the claim in addition to the sign or symptom for which there is suspicion of gastrointestinal illness (Group 1 code).
